verses.1: The spirit of Jehovah is upon me; therefore, Jehovah will make me a voice for those who are oppressed. I will be sent to comfort those whose hearts are broken. I will read to those who are lost and to those who are forbidden to speak. Open your hearts!
verses.2: May we live in the year of our desire for God, and may there be a day of retribution for our God, so that all sorrows may be healed.
verses.3: Let us place the ruins of Zion under a covering of gold. Under that covering, let us place them in a place where they can be protected from harm. Let us call upon Him, the Righteous One, to protect them. May the Lord bless them.
verses.4: And they built ruins from ancient times. The cities that were once built in those ruins were rebuilt and made new over time.
verses.5: And they stood there, foreigners who harmed your crops and your livestock, as well as your fruit trees.
verses.6: And you, priests of Jehovah, you shall be called “servants of our God.” It will be said to you: “You shall eat the offerings of other nations, and in their honor, you shall perform your duties.”
verses.7: Under your feet, they will be changed and transformed. Their share in this world will also be changed. They will inherit eternal joy.
verses.8: For I, the LORD, love justice. I will bring about its fulfillment, and I will truly fulfill their promises. I will make a eternal covenant with them.
verses.9: And in all the nations, their seeds and their descendants will be known among all peoples. They will be recognized as the seed of God’s blessing.
verses.10: May the Lord show me His kindness and compassion. May He cover me with garments of righteousness and justice. May He bless me with honor and glory. May He make me worthy to serve Him.
verses.11: For just as a land produces its crops and its trees bear fruit, so too will Jehovah’s temple bring forth righteousness and peace for all nations.
